title: Magic System Reference
summary: Open reference data for Quadrath's elemental and spell structures.

elements.description: Searing flames that burn and destroy.
Freezing cold that slows and shatters.
Crackling energy that strikes with speed and power.
Radiant energy with healing properties and special potency against undead and certain monstrous foes.
Shadowy, corrosive energy tied to secrecy and decay.

structures.description: One or more precise projectile attacks.
An area effect tempest of the chosen element.
A sustained stream of energy requiring focus.
A barrier that deflects or absorbs attacks.

special_types.description: Dragon-soul energy that amplifies a spell; usually requires a pact or ritual tied to the Dragon Kingdom.
Legendary magic that can alter battlefields or defy natural laws.

design_note: This document is a reference vocabulary. Precise spell costs, damage, cooldowns, and casting procedures belong in future spell entries or a game-master expansion.
